symptoms: Infinite hang on loading OAuth URL when starting auth from Companion App web UI
Go netdns resolver failure: lookup play.googleapis.com on [::1]:53 connection refused due to missing GODEBUG=netdns=cgo
Direct execution of agy.va39 bypassing the official C wrapper /data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/agy
WebView navigation via window.location.href to Google Accounts OAuth URL causes blank/blocked 403 disallowed_useragent and kicks user out of Companion App
hypothesis: Two distinct defects compound to break login in the web interface: (1) In server.py, start_login directly executes agy.va39 with ld-linux-aarch64.so.1 bypassing the official C wrapper /data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/agy and omitting GODEBUG=netdns=cgo and SSL_CERT_FILE. Without this, Go binaries in Termux glibc fail DNS queries on [::1]:53 because Android lacks /etc/resolv.conf, preventing agy from contacting Google to generate the OAuth URL. (2) In index.html, clicking the login link navigates the embedded Android WebView via window.location.href instead of delegating strictly to the system browser via termux-open-url (am start). Google explicitly blocks OAuth inside embedded WebViews (RFC 8252), causing the app view to freeze or show a blank loading screen.
fix_plan: Modify server/server.py to execute the official agy wrapper /data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/agy which handles resolv.conf and sets glibc environment.
Explicitly set GODEBUG=netdns=cgo, SSL_CERT_FILE=/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/etc/tls/cert.pem, and remove LD_PRELOAD in server.py process environments.
Add exports for GODEBUG and SSL_CERT_FILE in launch_server.sh to guarantee parent and child process health.

Modify server/web/index.html to remove window.location.href and preventDefault() on OAuth link click, keeping the Companion App WebView stable on 127.0.0.1:7681 while launching Chrome via termux-open-url.
